outreach.to: Personal-finance blogger jisne haal me is topic pe post likhi ho
outreach.subject: A free paycheck tool for your readers
outreach.body:
Hi [Name],

I enjoyed your post "[their post title]" — especially [one specific point].

I run HomeMoney Calc, a free, no-sign-up set of US money calculators. Our take-home paycheck calculator might be a useful extra for that post: https://homemoneycalc.com/paycheck-calculator/ (example: $75,000 salary in California → $2,081 per paycheck).

If it helps your readers, you're welcome to link it or embed it (free embed code is at the bottom of the page). No pressure at all if it's not a fit.

Thanks,
[Your name]
Founder, HomeMoney Calc
outreach.rules: Source, live link aur factual claims verify karo. Owner khud personalize karke bheje. No automatic sending, paid links ya link exchange.

ai.headline: Cloudflare monitoring verify karo aur 2027 tax update prepare karo
ai.summary: HomeMoney Calc ke live checks me Cloudflare ki taraf se 7 requests block hue hain, jisse monitoring incomplete hai. GSC par clicks 0 aur impressions 7 hain. 2027 tax brackets ke liye lib/tax engine update karne ka high priority task hai.
youDo: Cloudflare dashboard (dash.cloudflare.com) me jakar Security Events check karo ki monitoring requests kyun block ho rahi hain.
Apne browser me homemoney calc kholkar manual check karo ki site theek se khul rahi hai ya nahi.
lib/tax engine ke liye 2027 IRS brackets aur standard deduction data verify karke lib/tax2027.ts file par kaam shuru karo.
agentNext: Cloudflare edge settings aur bot protection rules analyze karke next report me update dena.
New roadmap tools jaise 'No Tax on Overtime Calculator' ki readiness track karna.
GA4 aur Search Console data sync hone par traffic growth metrics report me include karna.
risks: Cloudflare blocking ki wajah se automated monitoring tools ya search engines ko site access karne me dikkat aa sakti hai.
Abhi AdSense ke liye apply nahi karna hai kyunki traffic (clicks/impressions) abhi target se kam hai.
